Introduction to FME Form

This lesson covers the basics of FME Form 2024.2. Click the Run Translation button to begin.

You can open a workspace using File > Open Workspace or by pressing Ctrl+O.

What is a Workspace?

A workspace is a file with extension .fmw that stores your data transformation logic.

Use the Navigator panel to manage workspace settings.

1) Open Workbench

Start FME Workbench 2024.2 from the Start menu or taskbar.

  1. Click the Windows Start button.
  2. Type FME Workbench and press Enter.

Open an Existing Workspace

Use File > Open Workspace to load an existing .fmw file.

2) Add a Reader

Use the Add Reader dialog to connect to your source data.

  1. On the menu bar, click Readers > Add Reader.
  2. Set Format to Esri Shapefile.
  3. Click OK.

Resources

For more information, see the FME Documentation.
